content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To get constellation piercings, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Research reputable local piercing studios (2 hours)
Step 2. Check the studio's health inspection records (30 minutes)
Step 3. Select specific titanium jewelry pieces (45 minutes)
Step 4. Book a consultation appointment (10 minutes)
Step 5. Sign the legal waiver and consent forms (15 minutes)
Step 6. Discuss the desired "constellation" aesthetic with the piercer (30 minutes)
Step 7. Undergo ear anatomy assessment (20 minutes)
Step 8. Finalize the total cost and payment plan (15 minutes)
Step 9. Browse online portfolios for inspiration (1 hour)
Step 10. Purchase specialized aftercare saline solution (10 minutes)
Step 11. Confirm the jewelry gauge and length (10 minutes)
Step 12. Create a mood board of ear curation styles (2 hours)
Step 13. Verify the studio uses an autoclave for sterilization (20 minutes)
Step 14. Eat a high-protein meal before the appointment (1 hour)
Step 15. Save up the necessary funds for the procedure (2 weeks)
Step 16. Withdraw cash for a gratuity tip (15 minutes)
Step 17. Read reviews of specific piercers at the shop (1 hour)
Step 18. Measure the space on your ear lobes and cartilage (15 minutes)
Step 19. Check the piercer’s availability for the month (5 minutes)
Step 20. Clear your schedule for the afternoon of the piercing (10 minutes)
Step 21. Look up different types of constellation patterns (1 hour)
Step 22. Select the metal color, such as gold or silver (20 minutes)
Step 23. Buy a travel pillow to avoid sleeping on your ears (20 minutes)
Step 24. Set a calendar reminder for the appointment (2 minutes)
Step 25. Determine the number of piercings desired (10 minutes)
Step 26. Consult with a professional stylist on ear symmetry (3 hours)
Step 27. Choose between needle or dermal punch methods (30 minutes)
Step 28. Pick out the specific gemstone ends for the studs (40 minutes)
Step 29. Map out the approximate placement on a diagram (30 minutes)
Step 30. Disinfect your smartphone screen to prevent bacteria (5 minutes)
Step 31. Check for any metal allergies (2 days)
Step 32. Wash your hair thoroughly to keep the area clean (30 minutes)
Step 33. Ensure you have a valid government ID (10 minutes)
Step 34. Identify your budget for the entire project (1 hour)
Step 35. Ask about the studio's downsizing policy (15 minutes)
Step 36. Receive a briefing on the piercing process (20 minutes)
Step 37. Review the sterilization logs for the day (10 minutes)
Step 38. Search for "curated ear" trends on social media (2 hours)
Step 39. Confirm the shop's address and parking situation (15 minutes)
Step 40. Double-check the jewelry threading type (10 minutes)
Step 41. Select the placement for the primary "anchor" piercing (10 minutes)
Step 42. Arrange for a friend to drive you home (30 minutes)
Step 43. Interview the piercer about their experience (20 minutes)
Step 44. Take a "before" photo of your ears (5 minutes)
Step 45. Decide on the spacing between the "stars" (20 minutes)
Step 46. Consult a doctor if you have healing concerns (1 day)
Step 47. Plan your commute to the studio (20 minutes)
Step 48. Drink plenty of water to stay hydrated (1 hour)
Step 49. Clean your outer ears with mild soap (5 minutes)
Step 50. Research the healing time for various ear locations (3 hours)
Step 51. Inspect the jewelry for any visible defects (10 minutes)
Step 52. Pull your hair back with clips or a hair tie (5 minutes)
Step 53. Check the shop's policy on guest observers (10 minutes)
Step 54. Mark the skin with a surgical-grade pen (15 minutes)
Step 55. Confirm the piercer is wearing fresh gloves (2 minutes)
Step 56. Verify the placement in a mirror (10 minutes)
Step 57. Receive the actual piercings (30 minutes)
Step 58. Compare the portfolio photos to your ear shape (1 hour)
Step 59. Discuss the sequence of the piercings (10 minutes)
Step 60. Look for a studio with an APP certification (1 hour)
Step 61. Prepare an aftercare kit with gauze and tips (20 minutes)
Step 62. Register for the studio's loyalty program (5 minutes)
Step 63. Choose a piercer who specializes in fine linework (1 hour)
Step 64. Take a deep breath to relax your muscles (1 minute)
Step 65. Avoid taking blood thinners like aspirin (1 day)
Step 66. Listen to the piercer's jewelry recommendations (15 minutes)
Step 67. Sit in the sterile piercing chair (5 minutes)
Step 68. Ask about the difference between lobe and helix pain (10 minutes)
Step 69. Select a secondary accent jewelry piece (15 minutes)
Step 70. Cleanse the skin with an antiseptic wipe (5 minutes)
Step 71. Buy a gentle, fragrance-free soap (15 minutes)
Step 72. Adjust the marks based on the mirror view (10 minutes)
Step 73. Check that the needles are in sealed packaging (5 minutes)
Step 74. Pay the deposit for the appointment (5 minutes)
Step 75. Put your phone on silent mode (1 minute)
Step 76. Listen to the verbal aftercare instructions (10 minutes)
Step 77. Verify the studio's age requirements (10 minutes)
Step 78. Find a time when you aren't planning to swim (1 week)
Step 79. Check the studio's weekend hours (5 minutes)
Step 80. Take an "after" photo of the new constellation (5 minutes)
